threads.title: Bookmarks for the diaspora: Iradi sites that still open (add yours)

posts.body:
After Irad Day I made a list for the Association so the young ones stop asking me. Sites from home that open from America:

[b]News:[/b] [url=https://talasherald.com/]Talas Herald[/url] (the archive goes back to the nineties), [url=https://iradone.com/]IradOne[/url] (for the weather and to know what they want us to think), [url=https://mjsbroadbent.github.io/IradTimes/]Irad Times[/url] (hosted here in America, so it always opens for us; at home they need a VPN sometimes)
[b]People:[/b] [url=https://attelkom.net/users/Erbol8645/]Erbol's webring[/url] (sometimes broken)
[b]Buy and sell:[/b] [url=https://jilmay.com/]Jılmay[/url] (my nephew sold a Lada there)

Add yours. No VPN addresses here, FREEIRAD will delete them.
Good list Uncle. For the Times, read their [url=https://mjsbroadbent.github.io/IradTimes/access.html]access page[/url] before you send it to anyone at home, it explains what to do when it's blocked.
STILL NO. YOU MAY NOT ADD US TO A LIST CALLED "SITES THAT STILL OPEN". WE DO NOT OPEN. WE PERSIST.
adding: ilyasov's chat app, [url=https://tulparapp.com/]tulparapp.com[/url]. my whole family group moved there. it writes ñ and ö without fighting you lol

Adding the Attelkom map, [url=https://maps.attelkom.net/]Kartalar[/url]. Warning for the diaspora: it only opens on Attelkom connections, so from Chicago it's a grey page. Bookmark it for when you visit.
my mom says the best thing on this list is the Herald archive by year, [url=https://talasherald.com/archive/index.html]here[/url]. she reads 1995 every Sunday. one sentence, then two.
adding [url=https://jarysh.com/]jarysh.com[/url] but ONLY for the ulak scores. ignore everything else on it. everything.

And the university put its library online: [url=https://talasuniversity.org/]talasuniversity.org[/url]. Primary sources, finally. Extraordinary claims, ordinary evidence please, and now you can check.

threads.title: Jarysh got the Hippodrome Saturdays (seven years, no tender)

posts.body:
It's done. [url=https://talasherald.com/archive/2018/hippodrome-entertainment-rights-go-to-jarysh-group-for-seven-years-wit.html]Herald: Hippodrome entertainment rights go to Jarysh Group for seven years[/url]. Without a tender, obviously. A nightclub man runs Saturday nights at the State Hippodrome now.

Window 7 survived the Soviets. Window 7 will survive Nurik.
What does "entertainment rights" even mean at a hippodrome. The entertainment is the HORSES. Two thousand years of the Fergana horse and now there will be a DJ.
Horses do not lie. Promoters do. We will see who fills the stands.
honestly if there are lights at night and the ulak is on the big screen i'm going. kara-buura ulak forever

My cousin's wife says the Boss is very sensitive about that Dubai photo. His own site has the interview: [url=https://jarysh.com/news/nurik-dubai-world-cup.html]"just friends"[/url]. The canteen says otherwise. The canteen is never wrong (except when it is).

[url=https://talasherald.com/archive/2023/betting-site-behind-jarysh-odds-page-blocked.html]Herald: the betting site behind the Jarysh odds page is blocked[/url]. Good. Window 7 is the only legal window in Talas and the only honest one. The favourite always coughs.

Nurik's own website, read it and weep: [url=https://jarysh.com/news/hippodrome-concession-renewal.html]renewal "a formality"[/url]. The seven years ran out in 2025 and they are still there. Now it is a "formality". Akyel or nothing.
The stands are full. I said we would see. We saw. Horses do not lie, but they do not vote either.
